dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of Defense, military installations, and federal agencies like the Department of the Interior and NOAA.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Defense, in consultation with the Secretary of the Interior, the Administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and appropriate State agencies

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new planning, data collection, and reporting requirements without altering basic rights or daily civilian life.
dimensions.evidence: use the metrics, technology, and methodologies under paragraphs (5) and (6) of subsection (a)

dimensions.assessment: The source does not mention any specific appropriations or funding amounts.
Amends the Sikes Act to add new planning, standardized metrics, and reporting requirements for military natural resources management.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Sikes Act to make certain improvements to integrated natural resources management plans

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing management plans, reviews, and recurring reports to congressional committees every five years.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than two years after the date of the enactment of this Act, and five years thereafter

missing_information: Exact number of military installations affected
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates the Department of Defense to develop standardized metrics, use advanced technologies, and update integrated natural resources management plans across military installations. It creates procedural, reporting, and interagency review mechanisms but does not change major economic spending levels or directly affect the general public.
